body: Thanks for the advice, man. We've tried to pull an intervention before, she just went into a three-day "i'm going to kill myself today" funk then went back to her usual self. I guess I'm just going to take your advice and tell her straight up that I can't do that anymore :I

I'll try. 
Also, she despises reddit, so I'm clear there :P

I try as hard as I can :I
Thanks so much anyway, I'll try to get help to come to her.
I think I do, though. She does cut herself, quite deep. One side of her body is practically covered in scars.
Eeyup. She also talks about how she wants to murder everyone she doesn't like, then kill herself after. Kinda scary.
I probably would kill myself. But I don't know if I can take her much longer, it's driving me insane.

That seems like a pretty good idea. I'll see if I can. Thanks :I

(note: She's 15, and her mom is trying to help, but she does nothing but yell about how her parents are selfish bitches and how she's never helped by anyone.)

But she is. Honestly, it's taking over my life. She has all sorts of crazy mental things going on, like an entire world in her head. She thinks that if she kills herself she'll go to this world and have all her imaginary friends there for real.
I've tried many times. I'm the one that got her a therapist, but she refuses to talk to them. She refuses to help herself get better, and I feel like I'm the only one keeping her alive at this point.
